mandate: C417 — test the cross-sectional intraday CDOMIN: CROSS-SECTIONAL EXTREME DOMINANCE FREQUENCY stat-arb family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (1296 pre-registered configs). Per-bar primitives: perp_close real 5m kline close; log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0); abs_ret=|log_return|; dom[t]=argmax_i|r_i[t]| over the 10-asset cross section. CDOMIN scalars over fixed intrinsic window W=256 trailing returns: cdomin_freq[i,t]=(1/W)*sum_{s=t-W+1..t}1{dom[s]==i}; cdomin_asym[i,t]=cdomin_freq[i,t]-1/10. Needs indices t-W+1..t (W bars). NaN if t<W or any NaN/non-finite in the trailing window. Seasonal baseline = trailing mean/std at same (weekday,tod) bucket from history strictly before bar t (causal shift(1)), NaN-aware, excluding NaN obs. Signals: 2 real (cdomin_freq_dev, cdomin_asym_dev) + 2 placebos (phase-randomized surrogates, never edges). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (taker=fee+slip; maker_blend=0.5*fee+slip). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, signal-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: metric NaN unless sufficient finite obs; seasonal stats NaN-aware min_periods excluding NaN obs; NaN-score bars weight 0.

data_quality.note: metric NaN share dominated by finite-obs requirements (t<W=256 or NaN in trailing W-bar window).

methodology.raw_features: log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0) from real strictly-positive perp_close; abs_ret=|log_return|.
methodology.primitives: fixed intrinsic window W=256 trailing returns; dom[t]=argmax_i|r_i[t]| over the 10-asset cross section; cdomin_freq[i,t]=(1/W)*sum_{s=t-W+1..t}1{dom[s]==i}; cdomin_asym[i,t]=cdomin_freq[i,t]-1/10.
methodology.signals: cdomin_freq/cdomin_asym over fixed W=256; score=-(v-m)/sd with m/sd trailing same-bucket mean/std (min_periods=3, excluding NaN, causal shift(1)); cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; taker = fee+slip; maker_blend = 0.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 1296 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: mean |OOS net| per signal across all its configs; shares=|mean|/sum(|means|) over all 4 signals incl. placebos; dominant must be a real (non-placebo) signal with share >= 0.5 for attribution_ok.
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
methodology.placebo: phase-randomized surrogate via FFT phase randomization + rank restoration to original marginal; deterministic seed recorded; same marginal distribution, destroyed temporal alignment.
methodology.cdom_vectorization_note: return matrix R=(T,10) built once; abs matrix A=|R|; per-bar dom[s]=argmax_i A[i,s]; one-hot argmax matrix with prefix sums; trailing-window dominance frequency via prefix-sum differences gated on all-W-bars-finite; validated against brute-force per-window loop with maxdiff < 1e-12 in tests.
